findings.title: Missing current_user parameter in generate-next endpoint
findings.description: The route handler generate_next_audio_episode() does not declare `current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)` as a parameter, but the function body references `current_user.id` in 3 places (logger calls and balance operations). This causes a NameError at runtime.

findings.title: Missing ownership check in generate-next
findings.description: generate_next_audio_episode() does not verify that the material belongs to the current user. An attacker can call generate-next/{material_id} for another user's material and trigger TTS synthesis on their batch, consuming their credits.

findings.title: AiUsageLog integration is stubbed with TODOs
findings.description: Three cost-tracking operations (batch creation, episode generation, episode refund) are marked TODO and rely on logger.info instead of persisting to AiUsageLog. Cost mutations are not recorded in a persistent ledger, making cost audits impossible without parsing logs.

findings.title: Balance error response inconsistency between endpoints
findings.description: create_audio_batches returns HTTP 200 with ok=False on insufficient balance, while retry_audio_batch returns HTTP 402. The two endpoints handle the same error condition differently, which could confuse client-side error handling.

findings.title: Retry logic uses stale episode costs
findings.description: When retry_audio_batch executes, it recalculates total_retry_cost using the stored episode.cost_sv values from batch creation time. If TTS pricing changes between creation and retry, the retry uses the old rate instead of the current rate.

findings.title: Position endpoint updates first episode, not active episode
findings.description: save_audio_position always updates the position for the first episode in the batch (by topic_index, episode_index order). If the user jumps to a later episode, the position update still goes to the first one.

findings.title: Empty topics create zero-cost episodes that will fail
findings.description: Topics with zero or whitespace-only content are accepted and create episodes with cost_sv=0. These episodes will fail during TTS synthesis and require refund/retry. It would be cleaner to reject empty topics at batch-creation time.
